citation: John Carbutt, '11. Book Seller's Row, State Street.' Stereograph from Carbutt's Views of Chicago, c. 1868-1871. New York Public Library, Robert N. Dennis collection of stereoscopic views, MFY Dennis Coll 90-F169 (digital ID G90F169_004F).
author: John Carbutt, photographer, Chicago
repository: New York Public Library, Miriam and Ira D. Wallach Division of Art, Prints and Photographs: Photography Collection; catalog record b11707456.
locator: Booksellers' Row on State Street: a five-storey pale stone ('Athens marble') commercial palace front of identical units, round-arched windows, a heavy bracketed cornice, a cast-iron ground floor with plate glass and awnings.
rights_note: Created before 1871; public domain. NYPL marks the Dennis collection 'No known copyright restrictions'. Read for period forms only; no pixels are sampled and no geometry is traced.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-19 (T-3686) from NYPL's image server, digital ID G90F169_004F.
note: A street view, not a survey: it shows how the pre-fire business streets and residential blocks were built, not the fronts of the generated lots.
what_it_supplies: pale stone fronts of five storeys built as runs of identical units
round-arched upper windows and a heavy bracketed cornice
cast-iron ground-floor storefronts with plate glass, awnings
what_it_does_not_supply: the dimensions of any generated front
the colour of any particular stone front
